text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 5: XGBoost models given UKV, or ERA5 + UKV + ICON-D2 + ICON-EU + ICON global, track measured wind output'
text.tspan: Figure 5: XGBoost models given UKV, or ERA5 + UKV + ICON-D2 + ICON-EU +
ICON global, track measured wind output

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Hourly output as a percentage of capacity, measured and as predicted out of fold by each XGBoost model, averaged over its three fitting seeds. One row per generator; gaps are hours not covered by every product. Weeks chosen by rule from the weeks in which every generator has at least 12 scored hours on each of the seven days: the highest mean output, the largest mean hour-to-hour change, and the lowest mean output. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026.'
